name: Binny Mills Limited
about: Binny Mills Limited engages in renting, and trading business primarily in India. It operates through three divisions: Warehousing, Showrooms, and Textiles. The company rents warehouses; and retails textile materials. It also sells textile materials, including uniform materials, bedspreads, and other textile varieties. Binny Mills Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Chennai, India.
